H O W  Y O U  S P E A K  T O  Y O U R S E L F  I S  I M P O R T A N T
Our bodies do not forget, and all of what we have said about it and the
feelings it evoked in us, are embedded into it!
Mirror work has been an incredible way to start to bring awareness to how you view yourself!
Set a timer for 3 minutes and look at yourself in the mirror.
Take a deep breathe in through your nose
and out through your mouth, let the exhale be
longer than the inhale. Repeat this 3 times.
Scrunch your shoulders all the way up
to your ears and then drop them.
